description: An envelope and modulation generator with a bank of 16 morphing shapes, a screen you can draw your own shape on, and a cycle from 5ms to 30 minutes

params.text: Sets how long one cycle takes, from 5ms to 30 minutes
Morphs continuously through the bank of 16 shapes, from plucks and ramps to bells, ripples, stairs, bounces and drifts
Skews the shape in time, pushing its detail towards the start one way and the end the other
Carves rhythmic notches into the shape, deepening as it is turned up
Makes the envelope repeat, turning it into a modulation source rather than a one-shot

inputs.text: Moves the cycle length, 10V sweeping its whole range
Moves the shape morph, 10V sweeping its whole range
Moves the time skew, 5V sweeping its whole range
Moves the notch depth, 10V sweeping its whole range
A rising edge starts the envelope; it reads high above 1V and low below 0.1V

outputs.text: The envelope, 0-10V, or ±5V when the menu is set that way
A 1ms trigger at 10V each time the envelope reaches its end

notes: the screen can be drawn on: drag across it with the mouse and the envelope follows the drawing, with the time skew and the notches applied on top
the screen also shows the shape in use, a playhead moving through it, and the cycle time in seconds
menu: Bipolar output (±5V) — shifts the envelope output to run from -5V to 5V in place of 0-10V
Drawn shape (draw on screen) — switches between the shape you drew on the screen and the morphing bank of 16
Clear drawn shape — throws away the drawing and goes back to the bank
